system.description:
You cannot be Flanked. You can react to opponents on opposite sides of you as easily as you can react to a single attacker.

If you are the Pilot, this Talent applies to your Vehicle.

prerequisite.text: Acute Senses talent, Improved Initiative talent, and Uncanny Dodge I talent
